findings.claim: status() now reads `version` from the matching claude list entry, and a staged-copy mismatch is a separate problem.
install() declares scaccogatto at the chosen scope on every run.
_entry() filters by scope and, for project scope, by projectPath equal to cwd; project wins over user.
r1 asserts scope and projectPath for both ids; r2 asserts the first exit code and compares every listed plugin's version and scope.
_report takes PluginStatus and the older mypy errors are fixed; only the missing yaml stubs remain.

After a kmctl upgrade without update, status lists two problems with different fixes: 'installed plugin 0.2.0 ... run kmctl plugin update' and 'staged plugin 0.2.0 ... run kmctl plugin install'. Following the second runs install, which now refuses with 'run kmctl plugin update'. The staged-copy hint should name update when the installed version is also behind (or be left out then).

No test covers the f1 fix: a plain install over an older installed version must exit 1 naming kmctl plugin update, and status must report the installed-version mismatch. r5's test only edits the staged copy, so it passes even if the installed-version check is removed.

verdict.text: All five findings sent back are fixed, and I reproduced each fix against claude 2.1.300 with an isolated config.
Two small gaps remain, neither blocking: status gives two different fix commands after an upgrade (f6), and no test covers the installed-version check that f1 added (f7).

`loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: lint, format, tests and eval rows r1 to r6 all pass, "stamp green: 59c7d2b3165d159139d3a7e2a721ff6f6496adff8ce0d41a3f66af9e49d44193", which matches the round's fingerprint.
claude is on PATH, so the claude tests ran rather than skipped.
Read plugin.py in full, the plugin and review_due.py hunks of the diff, and tests/test_plugin_install.py.

Manual runs with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and XDG_DATA_HOME in the scratchpad and cli_version patched: install at 0.1.0 (exit 0), plain install at 0.2.0 (exit 1, "claude lists kmctl@kmctl at 0.1.0, not 0.2.0; run kmctl plugin update"), status (installed 0.1.0 mismatch), update (0.2.0, no problems).
In a second repo: status says "not installed here", install exits 0 and its .claude/settings.json declares both scaccogatto and kmctl marketplaces.
A user-scope install from a third repo is seen by status there, and the first repo's project entry still wins over the user entry.
mypy on src/kmctl: only the missing yaml stubs remain.
Rows r1 to r6: each test asserts its fails_when.
f1: resolved at plugin.py:186; the post-install check now fires, as reproduced above.
f2: resolved at plugin.py:158; the second repo's settings declare scaccogatto.
f3: resolved in `_entry`; test_status_ignores_other_repositories covers it and my run agreed.
f4: resolved; the r1 and r2 tests now check scope, projectPath and the first exit code.
f5: resolved; mypy is clean apart from third-party stubs.
f6: non-blocking, because a plain fix (change the hint text, or drop the staged problem when the installed one is reported) cannot ship a defect.
Every path still ends at update.

f7: non-blocking, because the behaviour works, as I checked by hand, and the fix only adds a test (patch cli_version after an install, then assert install exits 1 and status reports "installed plugin").
